· Position relative to SMA100 ($522.34)/SMA200 ($503.58): mixed medium-to-long term trend, support confirmed above SMA200.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI entering oversold and ADX showing no trend; consider buying on recovery above the 5-day low.
